title: House Sales in King County, Washington (May 2014 - May 2015)
dataAuthors: Public data from King County, Washington
relatedPublication: Moska et al. 2025. OBSR: Open Benchmark for Spatial Representations. SIGSPATIAL '25. https://doi.org/10.1145/3748636.3762783
conversion: scripts/datasets/convert-king-county.py (column selection, ISO dates, sort by sale date then parcel; no rows removed)
fingerprintBasis: SHA-256 of the decompressed CSV bytes. Gzip bytes can differ between zlib builds, so they are not the fingerprint.
independence: Recorded transactions published by a county government and redistributed by an unaffiliated university research group. Ascent's authors did not create, select or edit any record, and no shipped Ascent default was tuned on it.
limitations: One county and one 13-month period (2014-2015); results do not transfer to other markets or years without a new validation run.
Sale prices are recorded transfer prices; concessions, non-arm's-length transfers and data-entry errors are not flagged by the publisher.
Coordinates are rounded by the publisher (about 11 m latitude, about 75 m longitude).
